question: Who among the following won the ‘Golden Boot’ at FIFA World Cup 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harry Kane**__.

__
 
• **Harry Kane** won the **‘Golden Boot’ at FIFA World Cup 2018.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Harry Edward Kane is an **English professional footballer** who plays as a **striker for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur** and captains the England national team.
 
• He scored **six goals** in **FIFA World Cup 2018.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**__**Kylian Mbappe**__

__
 
• Kylian Mbappé Lottin is a **French professional footballer** who plays as a **forward for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain**.
 
• He won the **Best Young Player award** in the FIFA World cup 2018.

**Paul Pogba**__

__
 
• Paul Pogba is a French professional footballer who plays as a **central midfielder for Premier League club Manchester United**.

**Luka Modric**__

__
 
• Luka Modric is a **Croatian professional footballer** who plays as a **midfielder for Spanish club Real Madrid** and captains the Croatia national team.
 
• He won **one** **Ballon d 'Or award in 2018**.
 
• He also won the **Best FIFA Men's Player award in 2018**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Full form of FIFA - **International Federation of Association Football.**
 
• FIFA Founded - **21st May 1904.**
 
• FIFA Headquarter - **Zurich, Switzerland.**
 
• FIFA President - **Gianni Infantino (As of March 2022).**
 
• FIFA 2018 Men World Cup Winner - **France**
 
• FIFA 2019 Women World Cup Winner - **United States Of America.**
 
• FIFA 2022 Men World Cup Venue - **Qatar.**
 
• FIFA 2023 Women World Cup Venue - **Australia and New Zealand.**
